upstream.patch_preimages: Each complete edited file is SHA-256 pinned by native_boundary_patch.py before any overlay write.

overlay.output: Separate file overlay; patched files inherit only source read/execute bits and are verified non-writable.

hooks: direct Anthropic and Bedrock primary paths denied
retry/fallback/stream negotiation attempts that use those call sites
SDK automatic retries disabled for auxiliary OpenAI clients
exact tool-result message snapshot before transcript append

source_capture.authority_method: AuthorityClient.prepare_native_event(payload: bytes, parent_receipt_handles=(), purpose, intent_id, trace_id, retry_index=0)
source_capture.classification: private/unknown only; no human-origin or public clearance
source_capture.retry_index_header_semantics: Root-derived bounded decimal transport claim; gateway passes it to the root, which must compare it with the one-use event's stored retry index.
source_capture.attempt_semantics: Fresh complete SDK request-envelope capture and opaque bridge handle per attempted request; exact-envelope repeat increments retry_index with unchanged intent/trace and retained parents. Changed envelopes start a distinct intent at retry_index=0 until host retry admission is wired.
limits: The current worktree does not yet contain the HI11 AuthorityClient bridge API or enrolled producer-to-gateway pair.
Changed-envelope upstream fallback chains do not yet carry explicit root retry admission.
The current AuthorityClient API does not supply authenticated UI-origin, effect-result, memory-result, or public-clearance issuers.
Root broker must resolve full lineage and bind normalized final request digest, operation, purpose, generation, retry, cancellation and one-effect grant before egress.
Do not enable native provider egress from this overlay until the gateway-to-authority handle bridge is implemented and enrolled.

transport_controls.SDK_automatic_retries: forced to zero for primary request-scoped OpenAI clients and patched auxiliary OpenAI clients; Hermes-observed attempts require a fresh native event
transport_controls.request_timeout: clamped to the live host-issued event lease before SDK call
transport_controls.retry_admission: only exact-envelope repeats retain intent and increment retry_index; changed-envelope retries require an explicit host retry-admission integration

explicitly_uncovered: Hermes PluginContext.register(ctx) runtime-context injection and protected component/plugin loader
Auxiliary Anthropic/Bedrock/MoA internals and direct non-chat-completions paths
authenticated user-interface origin and public clearance
host effect broker bypass denial and actual target-native acceptance
acceptance: Patch-unit tests establish only exact-pin transformations, fail-closed source capture adapter behavior, digest/mode invariants and Python syntax. They do not establish installed native acceptance.
